nixos_to_guix.note: Each module of the NixOS port (nyymi609/fxtec-pro1x-nixos, read at commit 579356e) and the Guix code that translates it. Status is from TODO.md (last flash 2026-10-27) and the source at 018fa97. General lessons about the translation go in 'general'; the module-specific differences in 'instance'.

modules.title: hardware.nix -> hardware.scm and operating-system fields
modules.guix: fxtec-pro1x/services/hardware.scm, systems/*.scm (kernel, initrd-modules, bootloader, file-systems), device/udev/60-pro1x.rules
modules.general: A NixOS hardware module mixes things Guix splits: the kernel, initrd and bootloader are fields of operating-system, udev rules and firmware go through service extensions. Translate each NixOS option to the place Guix expects it, not to one service.
modules.instance: Boots, all expected kernel modules load, display and keyboard work (2026-10-27 flash). 2026-10-28: the udev rules from device/udev/60-pro1x.rules never reached udev (bare file given to udev-service-type); fixed with file->udev-rule, untested.

modules.title: boot-menu.nix and boot-success.nix -> boot.scm
modules.general: systemd oneshot units become Shepherd services with #:one-shot? #t. 'After=local-fs.target systemd-udev-settle.service' has no direct equivalent: require file-systems and udev and wait explicitly if needed.
modules.instance: A/B slot success marking (qbootctl) works. The per-generation menu split was earlier listed as working, which was wrong: with one generation on the phone it never wrote a prev*.conf, and its entry offset was wrong for Guix. The rootfs resize service is Guix-only (the NixOS image sizes itself differently). 2026-10-28: the split script kept NixOS's entry offset (N+2) and one-word labels; Guix needs N+1 and full labels. Fixed in f737b70, untested with several generations.

modules.title: usb-network.nix -> usb-network.scm
modules.general: Use full store paths for tools called from service code (iproute2, dnsmasq): a Shepherd service does not get the system profile's PATH.
modules.instance: usb0 at 172.16.42.1, ssh works. Guix version adds an empty DHCP router option so the host keeps its default route.

modules.title: keyboard.nix -> keyboard.scm
modules.general: NixOS's programs.dconf.profiles has no Guix service: write /etc/dconf/profile/user and /etc/dconf/db/local.d/* through etc-service-type and run 'dconf update' at activation.
modules.instance: keyd Fn layer works. Layout default changed to us+intl and persisted via a dconf system database (commit ac2eaa1); persistence across reboots not yet verified on the device. Keyboard backlight broken.
modules.source: commits ac2eaa1, d9f3e99; README port status

modules.title: modem.nix -> modem.scm
modules.guix: fxtec-pro1x/services/modem.scm, packages modem-manager 1.24 and libqmi 1.36 in the channel
modules.general: networking.modemmanager.enable in NixOS installs D-Bus policy, udev rules and polkit rules implicitly. On Guix each must be wired: dbus-root-service-type, udev-service-type, polkit-service-type extensions.
modules.instance: rmtfs and tqftpserv run. tqftpserv is patched (in both ports) to read firmware from /run/current-system/firmware, which Guix does not create: modem.scm creates the symlink from the firmware_class.path sysfs parameter at start. ModemManager exited at boot until the D-Bus extension was added; registration, SMS, calls and data untested.

modules.title: audio.nix -> audio.scm
modules.general: services.pipewire.enable in NixOS starts pipewire, pipewire-pulse and wireplumber as systemd user services and enables rtkit. Guix has no system-level PipeWire service equivalent of that: start them per user (home services or the session script), and add rtkit with the audio group realtime rule.
modules.instance: ALSA card Pro1X (sm4250) present, UCM2 paths and the WirePlumber Pro1X config installed, pro1x-audio-init runs. Missing: the PipeWire, pipewire-pulse and WirePlumber daemons, and rtkit. Audio silent.

modules.title: sensors.nix -> sensors.scm
modules.general: NixOS ExecStartPre waits (for /dev/fastrpc-adsp, for QRTR service 400) must become explicit wait loops in the Shepherd start code; Shepherd has no ExecStartPre.
modules.instance: pro1x-hexagonrpcd runs. The ACCEL_MOUNT_MATRIX udev rule exists in sensors.scm (line 125), so TODO.md section 5 is partly stale on that point. No wait for QRTR service 400 found before iio-sensor-proxy starts (grep for qrtr-lookup: no match). Auto-rotate not working.
modules.source: fxtec-pro1x/services/sensors.scm at 018fa97, read in source; TODO.md section 5

modules.title: camera.nix -> camera.scm
modules.general: NixOS sets environment on a specific systemd user service (systemd.user.services.<name>.environment). Guix has no user-service environment of that kind on a system without systemd; set the variable where the process is actually started, and verify it in /proc/<pid>/environ.
modules.instance: NixOS gives wireplumber LD_LIBRARY_PATH=pro1x-libcamera/lib. Guix writes it to /etc/environment.d, which is probably not read (see guix.json, environment.d entry). Camera kernel modules load.

modules.title: encryption.nix -> fde.scm and mobile-encrypted.scm
modules.general: The NixOS module runs in a systemd initrd. Guix's initrd is a Guile program: the unlock steps become a mapped-device with a custom open/close procedure, and every tool used must be in the initrd closure.
modules.instance: LUKS2 after a 256 MiB plain area, opened through a losetup offset loop device (see hardware.json). Never booted on the device.

modules.title: hosts/phosh -> systems/mobile.scm
modules.general: NixOS's phosh desktop manager option hides seat management, the session bus, schema compilation and the greeter. On Guix each one was a separate fix: seatd, dbus-run-session, schemas in the system profile, greetd.
modules.instance: Sway (Sxmo) session confirmed working through greetd + tuigreet. Phosh 0.56 packaged; the startup fixes (session bus, schemas, wlroots home-bar size) are in the source but Phosh starting is not confirmed on the device. GPU and touch untested.
